```c
/*
 * Multiplexing Spectrometer Channel
 * McStas 3.x instrument
 * 
 * Specification: Double-crystal analyzer spectrometer with monochromator,
 * sample position, and analyzer-detector arm. Includes wavelength and
 * position-sensitive diagnostics at key stages.
 */

DEFINE INSTRUMENT multiplexing_spectrometer(
    lam = 4.05,
    A1 = 37.14,
    A2 = 74.28
)

TRACE

COMPONENT src = Source_simple(
    yheight = 0.12,
    xwidth = 0.03,
    dist = 1.0,
    focus_xw = 0.03,
    focus_yh = 0.12,
    lambda0 = lam,
    dlambda = 0.4,
    flux = 1000000000000.0
)
AT [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT guide = Guide(
    w1 = 0.03,
    h1 = 0.12,
    w2 = 0.03,
    h2 = 0.12,
    l = 20.0,
    m = 2.0
)
AT [0, 0, 1.0] RELATIVE src

COMPONENT guide_exit_mon = L_monitor(
    nL = 200,
    filename = "guide_exit.dat",
    xwidth = 0.06,
    yheight = 0.12,
    Lmin = lam - 1,
    Lmax = lam + 1,
    restore_neutron = 1
)
AT [0, 0, 20.0] RELATIVE src

COMPONENT mono_arm = Arm()
AT [0, 0, 21.2] RELATIVE src

COMPONENT mono = Monochromator_flat(
    zwidth = 0.15,
    yheight = 0.12,
    mosaich = 40,
    mosaicv = 40,
    DM = 3.355
)
AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE mono_arm
ROTATED [0, A1, 0] RELATIVE mono_arm

COMPONENT out_arm = Arm()
AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE mono_arm
ROTATED [0, A2, 0] RELATIVE mono_arm

COMPONENT mono_lam = L_monitor(
    nL = 200,
    filename = "mono_lam.dat",
    xwidth = 0.06,
    yheight = 0.12,
    Lmin = lam - 1,
    Lmax = lam + 1,
    restore_neutron = 1
)
AT [0, 0, 0.8] RELATIVE out_arm

COMPONENT sample_psd = PSD_monitor(
    nx = 60,
    ny = 60,
    filename = "sample_psd.dat",
    xwidth = 0.05,
    yheight = 0.1,
    restore_neutron = 1
)
AT [0, 0, 1.5] RELATIVE out_arm

COMPONENT ana_arm = Arm()
AT [0, 0, 2.5] RELATIVE out_arm

COMPONENT ana = Monochromator_flat(
    zwidth = 0.12,
    yheight = 0.12,
    mosaich = 40,
    mosaicv = 40,
    DM = 3.355
)
AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ana_arm
ROTATED [0, -A1, 0] RELATIVE ana_arm

COMPONENT det_arm = Arm()
AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ana_arm
ROTATED [0, -A2, 0] RELATIVE ana_arm

COMPONENT det = PSD_monitor(
    nx = 60,
    ny = 60,
    filename = "det.dat",
    xwidth = 0.06,
    yheight = 0.12,
    restore_neutron = 1
)
AT [0, 0, 0.8] RELATIVE det_arm

COMPONENT det_lam = L_monitor(
    nL = 200,
    filename = "det_lam.dat",
    xwidth = 0.06,
    yheight = 0.12,
    Lmin = lam - 1,
    Lmax = lam + 1,
    restore_neutron = 1
)
AT [0, 0, 0.85] RELATIVE det_arm

END
```
